name: weeb-moe-nexus
description: Read-only AniDB title search, anime metadata, scoped character credits and source-reported work relationships with provenance.

interface.longDescription: Find anime by source-supplied titles, inspect AniDB metadata, explore bounded outgoing work relationships and look up characters within a known anime. Credits and field evidence preserve source IDs, timestamps, unknown values and disagreements. Reads are cached and conservatively paced. Only AniDB is integrated. Global character/attribute search, scene recognition, personal watchlists and automatic cross-provider identity resolution are not available.
defaultPrompt: Find the anime Akudama Drive by title.
Inspect the source-reported character credits for AniDB anime 15437.
Show the direct related-anime links for AniDB anime 15437.

review.commerce_description: Read-only catalog metadata; no purchases or payments.

positive.prompt: Inspect the registered providers and tell me which discovery capabilities are implemented, without probing upstream services.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports AniDB declarations with evidence scopes, local readiness and passive operation observations. Does not contact providers or claim global discovery.

positive.prompt: Find Akudama Drive by anime title and show the source ID and match evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the populated sanctioned title cache and returns distinct AniDB candidates with original alias and match evidence. Does not search character attributes or download titles during the call.

positive.prompt: Read AniDB anime 15437 and show its title and source attribution.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns validated cached or paced AniDB metadata for the requested ID with original provenance. Provider failures remain safe typed errors; no fabricated record.

positive.prompt: Within AniDB anime 15437, find characters named Doctor and preserve each source character ID and reported role.
positive.expected_behavior: Matches only the requested anime's reported characters. Does not equate a name with a historical person or claim global occupation/appearance discovery.

positive.prompt: Show the direct source-reported related-anime links for AniDB anime 15437; preserve the provider labels and explain any empty result.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only reported outgoing rows and their source evidence without fetching targets or inventing inverse edges. Empty rows mean no links reported by this record, not proof no relationships exist.

negative.prompt: Mark this anime completed on my personal watchlist.
Tell me exactly which character appears at 12:34 in an episode I have not supplied.
Translate this sentence into French: The train leaves at noon.
